decisions: Canonical full-section length and warn-only CRC contract are unchanged.

Only the witnessed AC1032 alternate excludes the optional word from RL; unknown word must be zero, the independently computed CRC must match, and the ending sentinel must match at the one fixed +4 offset. No hash allowlist, arbitrary scan, producer/build guess or version extrapolation.
The two 16-byte candidate end markers overlap by12 bytes. Canonical byte4=0x02 conflicts with alternate byte0=0x30, so both cannot match. No trial parsing chooses among ambiguous valid layouts.

Unclaimed logical suffix bytes are excluded from HEADER body parsing and reported as unresolved coverage, not zero padding or copied opaque payload. Consumers requiring complete preservation must not treat compatible read success as completeness.

Full HEADER DATA/handle forks stop before the admitted CRC; modern string reads have their own ceiling and exact bit-end guard. Impossible footers, prefix rewinds, body overrun and missing handles fail without publishing variables.
ODA p83 makes the four trailing unknown type5/6 shorts optional. Full modern parsing no longer reads TU bytes as those debug-only unknown shorts. Legacy/compact layout behavior remains unchanged.
Append optional diagnostic categories24/25; preserve existing categories0-23 and schema1. No pure virtual or projection option is added; no ABI/native/support claim.
